news.titleEn: Magnitude-7.7 Earthquake Strikes Off Indonesia's Coast, Killing at Least 47
news.conclusionEn: A magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck off Indonesia's Flores Island early Saturday, killing at least 47 people and triggering landslides that cut off remote villages, with a tsunami warning issued for several provinces.
news.conclusionZh: 印尼弗洛勒斯岛附近周六发生7.7级地震，已致至少47人死亡，多省一度发布海啸预警。
news.whyEn: The quake struck one of Indonesia's most disaster-prone regions, where a similar event in 1992 killed roughly 2,500 people, and rescuers warn the death toll could keep rising as landslides have buried or isolated villages across six regencies.
news.whyZh: 该地区历史上曾发生致命地震海啸，救援人员警告死亡人数仍可能上升，因山体滑坡已掩埋或切断多个村庄。
news.detailEn: The earthquake struck at 5:58am local time about 68 kilometers north-northwest of the city of Ende in East Nusa Tenggara province, with more than 230 aftershocks recorded through the day, the strongest measuring magnitude 6.2. Indonesian authorities initially issued a tsunami warning for East Nusa Tenggara, West Nusa Tenggara, South Sulawesi and Southeast Sulawesi provinces and urged residents to move away from coastlines and riverbanks. Landslides triggered by the quake have buried or cut off access to remote villages across six regencies on Flores Island, complicating rescue efforts. Officials say the toll is likely to rise as search teams reach isolated areas; the region has a history of devastating seismic events, including a 1992 earthquake and tsunami that killed about 2,500 people on Flores.
news.detailZh: 地震于当地时间周六凌晨5点58分发生，震中位于东努沙登加拉省安德市西北约68公里处，当天记录到230多次余震，最强达6.2级。印尼当局一度对东努沙登加拉、西努沙登加拉、南苏拉威西及东南苏拉威西省发布海啸预警，敦促居民远离海岸及河岸。地震引发的山体滑坡掩埋或切断了弗洛勒斯岛六个县多个偏远村庄的对外通道，救援工作因此受阻。官员表示，随着搜救队伍抵达偏远地区，死亡人数很可能进一步上升；该地区历史上曾发生毁灭性地震，1992年一次地震海啸曾在弗洛勒斯岛造成约2500人死亡。

news.titleEn: Russian Ballistic Attacks Intensify as Kyiv Claims Dnipropetrovsk Advance
news.conclusionEn: Ukraine says it has recaptured 745 square kilometers of territory in its southern Dnipropetrovsk region this year, even as Russia escalates ballistic and hypersonic missile strikes, firing 56 such missiles at Ukraine in the first week of August alone.
news.conclusionZh: 乌克兰称今年已在南部第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州收复745平方公里领土，同时俄罗斯正加大弹道及高超音速导弹攻势。
news.whyEn: The territorial claim and the missile escalation together signal neither side is close to a battlefield off-ramp, keeping pressure on European energy and defense spending and complicating any near-term diplomatic settlement.
news.whyZh: 双方在战场上均未显露让步迹象，持续消耗将加剧欧洲能源与防务支出压力，也让短期外交解决方案更难达成。
news.detailEn: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukrainian forces completed a campaign to recapture 745 square kilometers in the southern Dnipropetrovsk region this year, claiming close to 10,000 Russian soldiers were killed in the process. At the same time, Russia has ramped up its missile campaign, producing more than 100 ballistic and hypersonic missiles a month and firing 56 of them at Ukrainian targets in the first week of August alone, according to Ukrainian officials, who also say North Korea is moving up to 120 ballistic missiles to a Russian base near the Ukrainian border. On August 14 alone, Ukrainian forces reported 194 combat clashes along the front line, with the heaviest fighting around Kostiantynivka. Total Russian personnel losses since the 2022 invasion now stand at an estimated 1.46 million, according to Ukraine's General Staff.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，乌军今年已完成在南部第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州收复745平方公里领土的行动，称此过程中俄军阵亡人数接近1万人。与此同时，俄罗斯导弹攻势不断升级，据乌克兰官员介绍，俄方月产弹道及高超音速导弹超过100枚，仅8月第一周就向乌克兰目标发射56枚；乌方还称朝鲜正向俄罗斯靠近乌边境的一处基地调运多达120枚弹道导弹。仅8月14日当天，乌军就在前线报告194次交火，战斗最激烈的地区集中在科斯佳延基夫卡。据乌克兰总参谋部统计，自2022年俄罗斯发动入侵以来，俄军人员损失总数已达约146万人。

news.titleEn: Nvidia Has $21 Billion SpaceX Stake, $30 Billion in Intel Shares
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia disclosed holdings of roughly $21 billion in Elon Musk's SpaceX and about $30 billion in Intel shares, revealing the scale of its strategic stakes across the chip and space industries.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达披露其持有埃隆·马斯克旗下SpaceX约210亿美元股权，及英特尔约300亿美元股份，凸显其战略投资版图之广。
news.whyEn: The disclosure shows Nvidia increasingly acting as a financier and equity holder across its own supply chain and customer base, deepening ties that could amplify returns in an AI boom but also raises questions about concentrated risk if valuations reverse.
news.whyZh: 英伟达日益扮演产业链投融资角色，虽可能在AI热潮中放大收益，但持仓过度集中也令外界担忧一旦估值回调将带来连锁风险。
news.detailEn: New disclosures show Nvidia's investment portfolio has grown to include a stake in SpaceX worth approximately $21 billion and an Intel shareholding worth about $30 billion, underscoring how central the chipmaker has become to financing the broader AI and technology supply chain. The Intel stake follows a direct investment Nvidia made in the struggling chipmaker earlier this year as part of a manufacturing and product partnership, while the SpaceX position reflects a bet on Musk's satellite and rocket ventures. The disclosures come as Nvidia is separately mobilizing hundreds of billions of dollars in third-party financing with Wall Street firms to help customers buy its chips, prompting analysts to note that the company's balance sheet is becoming increasingly intertwined with the fortunes of the companies it invests in and sells to.
news.detailZh: 最新披露显示，英伟达的投资组合已包括价值约210亿美元的SpaceX股权，以及约300亿美元的英特尔持股，凸显这家芯片巨头在为整个AI及科技产业链融资中所扮演的核心角色。英特尔持股源于英伟达今年早些时候对这家陷入困境的芯片制造商的直接投资，作为双方制造与产品合作的一部分；而SpaceX持仓则体现了英伟达对马斯克旗下卫星与火箭业务的押注。此次披露之际，英伟达正另行联合华尔街机构撬动数千亿美元第三方资金，以帮助客户采购其芯片，分析人士指出，该公司的资产负债表正与其投资及销售对象的命运日益交织。

news.titleEn: SEC Cancels Crypto Fundraising Meeting, Leaving Token Issuers With No New Path to Fund Development
news.conclusionEn: The SEC abruptly canceled its August 14 meeting to vote on 'Regulation Crypto,' a proposed framework that would have let crypto startups raise up to $75 million a year without full securities registration, citing an unforeseen scheduling issue.
news.conclusionZh: 美国SEC突然取消原定8月14日的「加密监管新规」投票会议，该新规本可让加密初创企业每年最高融资7500万美元且免于完整证券注册。
news.whyEn: The delay leaves crypto startups without a clearer legal path to raise capital just as the broader Clarity Act market-structure bill remains stalled in the Senate, prolonging regulatory uncertainty for the industry heading into the fall.
news.whyZh: 监管新规延后使加密初创企业融资仍缺乏明确法律路径，叠加参议院《明晰法案》迟迟未获表决，行业监管不确定性将持续到秋季。
news.detailEn: The Securities and Exchange Commission canceled a scheduled August 14 meeting at which commissioners were set to vote on proposing 'Regulation Crypto,' a rulemaking package built around three pathways: a roughly $5 million exemption for very early-stage startups, a broader exemption allowing raises of up to $75 million in any 12-month period, and a 'decentralization safe harbor' that would let sufficiently decentralized token networks exit securities classification altogether. No new date has been set for the vote. The cancellation comes as the Clarity Act, the crypto market-structure bill meant to clarify SEC and CFTC jurisdiction over digital assets, failed to get a Senate vote before the August recess; Majority Leader John Thune has scheduled a procedural vote for mid-September, leaving token issuers without a clear regulatory path in the meantime.
news.detailZh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）取消了原定8月14日举行的会议，委员会本应在该会议上就提出「加密监管新规」进行投票，该规则围绕三条路径设计：面向极早期初创企业约500万美元的融资豁免、允许任意12个月内最高融资7500万美元的更广泛豁免，以及让去中心化程度足够高的代币网络彻底退出证券分类的「去中心化安全港」条款。目前尚未公布新的投票日期。此次取消正值旨在厘清SEC与CFTC对数字资产监管权限的《明晰法案》未能在参议院休会前获得表决，参议院多数党领袖约翰·图恩已将程序性投票安排在9月中旬，这期间加密代币发行方仍缺乏明确的监管路径。

news.titleEn: US Court Says Trump Can Halt Tariff Exemption for Low-Cost Goods
news.conclusionEn: A US trade court rejected a legal challenge to the Trump administration's removal of the 'de minimis' exemption, allowing tariffs to keep applying to imported packages worth $800 or less.
news.conclusionZh: 美国贸易法院驳回对特朗普政府取消「小额免税」政策的诉讼，800美元以下低价值进口包裹仍需缴纳关税。
news.whyEn: The ruling affects the flood of low-cost e-commerce shipments from platforms like Shein and Temu into the US, raising costs for consumers and cross-border retailers and closing off a legal avenue that had offered hope of restoring the exemption.
news.whyZh: 该裁决影响Shein、Temu等平台大量低价商品对美出口，将推高消费者及跨境电商成本，也堵住了恢复免税政策的司法途径。
news.detailEn: The US Court of International Trade rejected a challenge to executive orders the Trump administration issued over the past year eliminating the de minimis exemption, which previously let packages valued at $800 or less enter the US duty-free. The ruling means the administration can continue collecting tariffs on low-dollar imports, a policy that has significantly raised costs for shipments from Chinese e-commerce platforms such as Shein and Temu as well as everyday cross-border parcels. The decision comes as part of a broader pattern of courts largely declining to block the administration's tariff actions, even as separate legal challenges to the president's broader use of emergency powers to impose tariffs remain pending elsewhere in the federal court system.
news.detailZh: 美国国际贸易法院驳回了针对特朗普政府过去一年发布的取消「小额免税」行政令的诉讼，此前该政策允许价值800美元以下的包裹免税进入美国。裁决意味着政府可继续对低价值进口商品征收关税，这一政策已显著推高Shein、Temu等中国电商平台商品及日常跨境包裹的成本。此次裁决延续了法院普遍未阻止政府关税行动的整体趋势，尽管针对总统以紧急状态权力大规模加征关税的其他诉讼仍在联邦法院系统的其他案件中悬而未决。

news.titleEn: Ambassador Greer Issues Statement on President Trump Imposing Section 338 Tariffs on Canada
news.conclusionEn: New 50% US tariffs on select Canadian imports — including motor vehicles, alcoholic beverages and dairy products — take effect August 19, marking the first-ever use of the century-old Section 338 authority against a trading partner.
news.conclusionZh: 针对加拿大汽车、酒类及乳制品等商品的50%新关税将于8月19日生效，这是美国首次动用近百年历史的第338条关税授权。
news.whyEn: Section 338 has never been invoked before, so its use against a close ally and top trading partner sets a legal precedent the administration could extend to other countries, while covering roughly $20 billion in annual Canadian imports and inviting likely retaliation.
news.whyZh: 第338条从未被援引过，此次针对重要盟友和贸易伙伴使用开创先例，涉及约200亿美元年度进口，也可能招致加拿大反制。
news.detailEn: President Trump issued three proclamations imposing 50% tariffs on Canadian motor vehicles, alcoholic beverages and dairy products under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, the first time any US president has used this authority since it was written nearly a century ago. The tariffs take effect at 12:01am Eastern time on August 19 for goods entered for consumption on or after that date, and apply regardless of whether the goods would otherwise qualify for preferential treatment under the USMCA trade agreement. The administration cites Canadian practices such as provincial liquor-board restrictions on US alcohol sales and dairy supply-management quotas as discriminatory conduct justifying the tariffs. Together the three proclamations cover close to $20 billion of annual US imports from Canada, about 5% of total Canadian goods imports, and add another flashpoint to the ongoing renegotiation of North American trade terms.
news.detailZh: 特朗普总统签署三项公告，依据1930年《关税法》第338条对加拿大汽车、酒类及乳制品加征50%关税，这是该条款近百年历史上首次被美国总统动用。相关关税将于8月19日美东时间凌晨0点01分对当日及以后消费入境的商品生效，且无论相关商品是否本可依据《美墨加协定》享受优惠待遇均一律适用。美国政府称，加拿大各省酒类专卖限制及乳制品供应管理配额等做法构成歧视性行为，是加征关税的依据。三项公告合计涉及美国自加拿大年进口额约200亿美元，约占加拿大对美出口总额的5%，为持续进行中的北美贸易条款重新谈判再添一大焦点。

news.titleEn: Teledyne to Acquire Varex Imaging Corporation
news.conclusionEn: Teledyne Technologies agreed to acquire Varex Imaging for $18.90 per share in cash, an all-cash deal worth approximately $1.1 billion, expanding Teledyne's medical and industrial imaging business.
news.conclusionZh: 泰雷达科技同意以每股18.90美元现金收购Varex Imaging，总交易额约11亿美元，借此扩充其医疗及工业成像业务。
news.whyEn: The deal adds Varex's X-ray tube and digital detector technology to Teledyne's imaging portfolio, a sign that mid-sized industrial and medical-technology consolidation is continuing even as investor attention stays fixed on mega-cap AI deals.
news.whyZh: 交易将Varex的X射线管及数字探测器技术并入泰雷达影像业务，显示在市场聚焦AI巨头交易之际，中型工业与医疗科技并购仍在持续。
news.detailEn: Teledyne Technologies and Varex Imaging jointly announced a definitive agreement under which Teledyne will acquire all outstanding Varex shares for $18.90 each in cash, valuing the deal at approximately $1.1 billion including equity awards and net debt. Varex designs and manufactures X-ray tubes, digital detectors and other imaging components used in medical diagnostics, industrial inspection, security screening and vehicle inspection. Both companies' boards unanimously approved the transaction, which is expected to close in early 2027 pending regulatory approvals and a Varex shareholder vote. The acquisition builds out Teledyne's existing medical and industrial imaging segment, adding specialized X-ray hardware to a portfolio that already spans sensors, instrumentation and aerospace and defense electronics.
news.detailZh: 泰雷达科技与Varex Imaging联合宣布已达成最终协议，泰雷达将以每股18.90美元现金收购Varex全部流通股份，计入股权激励及净债务后，交易总额约为11亿美元。Varex主要设计和制造用于医疗诊断、工业检测、安检及车辆检查的X射线管、数字探测器及其他成像部件。两家公司董事会已一致批准该交易，预计将在获得监管批准及Varex股东投票通过后于2027年初完成交割。此次收购扩充了泰雷达现有的医疗与工业成像业务板块，为其原本涵盖传感器、仪器仪表以及航空航天与防务电子产品的业务组合再添专业X射线硬件。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money, or effort into a decision because of what has already been spent, rather than evaluating whether it still makes sense going forward. Money and time already spent are gone regardless of what you do next, so a rational decision should only weigh future costs and benefits. Managers who fall into this trap often keep funding failing projects just because 'we've already put so much into it.'
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指人们因为已经投入的时间、金钱或精力而继续投入某项决策，而不是理性评估该决策今后是否仍然划算。已经花掉的钱和时间无论接下来怎么做都无法收回，理性决策应只考虑未来的成本与收益。陷入这一误区的管理者常常仅因「已经投入这么多了」而继续为失败的项目输血。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $2 million building a new internal software tool that employees still refuse to use after 18 months. Leadership keeps funding it because of the sunk $2 million, instead of asking whether the remaining budget would be better spent buying an off-the-shelf solution.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司已花费200万美元开发一款内部软件工具，18个月过去了员工依然拒绝使用。管理层仅因「已经投入了200万美元」就继续为该项目拨款，而没有去思考剩余预算用来购买现成解决方案是否更划算。

businessTips.explanationEn: An MVP is the simplest version of a product that still lets you test a core assumption with real customers, before investing in a fully-featured build. The goal isn't to launch something incomplete for its own sake, but to learn as cheaply and quickly as possible whether people actually want what you're building, following a build-measure-learn loop. Many successful startups began as a scrappy MVP that looked nothing like the polished product they later became.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指在投入资源打造功能完善的成品之前，先用最简版本向真实客户验证核心假设。做MVP的目的不是为了「凑合上线」，而是以最低成本、最快速度验证人们是否真的需要你在做的东西，遵循「构建-测量-学习」的循环。许多成功的创业公司最初都是从一个粗糙的MVP起步，与后来打磨成熟的产品判若两样。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before building a full subscription meal-kit app, a side-hustle founder simply posts a weekly menu on Instagram and takes orders via direct message, using a spreadsheet to track deliveries. If enough people pay for a few weeks in a row, that validates demand before any app gets built.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位副业创业者在开发完整的订阅制餐盒App之前，先在Instagram上发布每周菜单，通过私信接单，并用表格手动跟踪配送。如果连续几周都有足够多的人愿意付费，这就在开发App之前验证了真实需求。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how sensitive a bond's price is to changes in interest rates — roughly, the percentage a bond's price will move for every 1% change in rates. A bond with a duration of 7 years will lose about 7% of its value if rates rise by 1 percentage point, and gain roughly the same if rates fall. Longer-maturity bonds generally have higher duration, which is why bond investors watch central bank decisions, like the Federal Reserve's upcoming September meeting, so closely.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期衡量债券价格对利率变动的敏感程度——大致而言，是利率每变动1%，债券价格相应变动的百分比。久期为7年的债券，若利率上升1个百分点，价格大约会下跌7%；利率下降1个百分点，价格则大约上涨7%。期限越长的债券通常久期越高，这也是为什么债券投资者会如此密切关注美联储9月议息会议等央行决策。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor holding a 20-year Treasury bond with a duration of about 15 years sees its price drop roughly 15% if the Fed unexpectedly raises rates by 1 percentage point, while a colleague holding a 2-year note with a duration near 2 loses far less, illustrating why longer bonds carry more interest-rate risk.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者持有久期约15年的20年期美国国债，若美联储意外加息1个百分点，其债券价格约下跌15%；而另一位持有久期约2年的2年期国债的同事，跌幅则小得多，这正说明期限越长的债券承担的利率风险越大。
